title: Des anges
overview: Both aged twelve, Jeremy and his pal Abed live in a desolate neighborhood outside Paris. As they are bored they decide to go to Paris but as this is August, the empty streets of the capital are as boring as their usual environment. To kill time they do nasty things, such as annoying a man in a telephone booth or lashing out at a friend. After a while, they meet a girl, older than them ...
